# Knowledge Nodes

The fact record: facts about an entity, an entity's current state, the timeline between two entities, and grant/revoke knowledge edges.

_5 nodes._

| Node | Registry path |
| --- | --- |
| [Current State](#current-state) | `knowledge/CurrentState` |
| [Facts About](#facts-about) | `knowledge/FactsAbout` |
| [Grant Knowledge](#grant-knowledge) | `knowledge/GrantKnowledge` |
| [Relationship Timeline](#relationship-timeline) | `knowledge/RelationshipTimeline` |
| [Revoke Knowledge](#revoke-knowledge) | `knowledge/RevokeKnowledge` |

## Current State

`knowledge/CurrentState`

The newest fact about an entity that no later fact supersedes.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `str` | name of the entity |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fact` | `knowledge/fact` | the fact dict, or None |
| `text` | `str` | the fact text, or an empty string |

## Facts About

`knowledge/FactsAbout`

Facts recorded about an entity (character, item or place), oldest first.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `str` | name of the entity |
| `character` | `str` | (optional) optional, only the facts this character knows |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facts` | `list` | list of fact dicts |
| `text` | `str` | the facts as one line per fact |

## Grant Knowledge

`knowledge/GrantKnowledge`

Grant a character knowledge of an entry (a fact id, a sheet entry id,
a world entry id or a summarized history entry id).

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str` | character name |
| `target` | `str` | entry id |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | the stored edge |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |

## Relationship Timeline

`knowledge/RelationshipTimeline`

Facts that mention both entities, oldest first.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | `str` | first entity |
| `b` | `str` | second entity |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facts` | `list` | list of fact dicts |
| `text` | `str` | one line per fact |

## Revoke Knowledge

`knowledge/RevokeKnowledge`

Revoke a character's knowledge of an entry.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str` | character name |
| `target` | `str` | entry id |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | the stored edge |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |
